customTitle: Pichi Invoice Generator v1.0.0 Official Release
customMessage: Pichi Invoice Generator v1.0.0 is now available with the new Count-Only Dashboard, About section, and Google Sheets integration.
releaseNotes: Official release of Pichi Invoice Generator v1.0.0.
whatsNew: Count-Only Dashboard with zero financial amount exposure
Dedicated About section with developer profile, contact details, and privacy policy
Google OAuth sign-in with auto-provisioning dedicated Google Sheets database
Professional A5 invoice generator with instant preview and PDF export
Automated update checking system powered by GitHub
improvements: Seamless Windows titlebar controls and restore behavior
Optimized memory usage and cold startup speed
importantNotices: Requires an authorized Google Account to sign in and synchronize with Google Sheets.
Both Setup Installer and Portable versions are available.
